paragraphs.text: Ignacio Treviño Salcido participated in Founding of Pacto del Faro Gris on 2011-01-22. Pacto del Faro Gris was linked to Founding of Pacto del Faro Gris on 2011-01-22. Founding of Pacto del Faro Gris occurred at Veracruz on 2011-01-22. A trucking dispatcher with regular business at the Veracruz docks reported that three port crews that had competed for dock access agreed to operate as a single pact under Treviño, a longshoremen's leader whom the docks called El Faro. The dispatcher stated that the pact pooled access at Veracruz, Tuxpan and Tampico and divided the trucking lanes along the Gulf highway among the three crews.

Lorena Mijares Ocampo participated in Founding of Pacto del Faro Gris on 2011-01-22. Ignacio Treviño Salcido used DEMO-TEL-00095 on 2011-01-22. Pacto del Faro Gris controlled Veracruz port plaza from 2011-01-22 until 2023-11-14. The dispatcher identified Mijares as Treviño's deputy and as the person who negotiated the lane division with the Tuxpan crew. The telephone identifier above was the one Treviño used to call the dispatcher about lane assignments. The dispatcher stated that the pact's control of the Veracruz docks was immediate and complete.

Ignacio Treviño Salcido led Pacto del Faro Gris from 2011-01-22 until 2016-03-09. Ignacio Treviño Salcido was a member of Pacto del Faro Gris from 2011-01-22 until 2016-03-09. The dispatcher characterized Treviño as a cautious leader who preferred to be seen as a union figure. The reporting office assesses the dispatcher as having direct access to the dock arrangements and as a reliable reporter on lane assignments. The reporting office notes that the pact's control of the Tampico docks is described in other reporting and is not covered by this source.
